Hexa Flip Stainless Steel Mug with Flip Top Lid – 400ml Double Wall Design

The Hexa Flip Stainless Steel Mug with Flip Top Lid is designed for those who value durability, elegance, and everyday convenience. With a practical capacity of 400ml (approx.), this premium mug is ideal for coffee, tea, or any hot and cold beverages at home, office, or on the go. Crafted using high-quality stainless steel and finished with a sleek mirror polish, it offers both performance and modern aesthetics.

Built with a double wall stainless steel mug construction, the Hexa Flip mug helps maintain beverage temperature for longer while keeping the exterior comfortable to hold. The insulated design minimizes heat transfer, making it suitable for daily use without condensation or excessive heat on the surface.

Premium Stainless Steel with Mirror Finish

This stainless steel mug with mirror finish reflects a refined look that fits effortlessly into professional and lifestyle environments. The corrosion-resistant steel ensures long-lasting shine, hygiene, and strength. Unlike ordinary mugs, this double wall mug is designed to withstand regular use while retaining its polished appearance.

The flip top cap is engineered for ease of use and spill resistance. It allows smooth one-hand operation, making it perfect for office desks, travel, meetings, or daily commutes. The secure flip lid helps prevent accidental spills and keeps your beverage protected.

Designed for Comfort, Utility, and Daily Use

With an ergonomic shape and balanced weight, the Hexa Flip fits comfortably in your hand. The 400ml stainless steel capacity makes it ideal for serving standard beverage portions without frequent refills. Whether you enjoy hot coffee, green tea, or chilled drinks, this insulated mug delivers consistent performance. The double wall design also helps preserve flavor by maintaining stable internal temperatures. This makes it a reliable option for professionals, travelers, and gifting purposes.

Key Features

  • Premium stainless steel mug with durable mirror finish
  • Capacity 400ml (approx.) – ideal for daily beverages
  • Advanced double wall mug construction for insulation
  • Convenient and secure flip top lid design
  • Comfortable grip with condensation-free exterior
  • Rust-resistant, hygienic, and easy to clean
  • Suitable for office, travel, home, and gifting

Versatile Usage & Gifting Option

The Hexa Flip Stainless Steel is a versatile solution for modern lifestyles. Its sleek appearance and functional design make it a popular choice for corporate gifting, promotional use, and personal consumption. The sturdy construction ensures durability, while the flip top cap adds a layer of convenience for busy routines. This stainless steel double wall mug is also an eco-friendly alternative to disposable cups, supporting sustainable habits without compromising on style or performance.

Why Choose Hexa Flip?

When compared to ordinary drinkware, the Hexa Flip stands out due to its premium materials, thoughtful design, and reliable insulation. The mirror finish stainless steel body delivers a sophisticated look, while the 400ml capacity makes it practical for everyday hydration needs. Whether you are upgrading your office essentials or selecting a refined gift, the offers a perfect balance of durability, functionality, and visual appeal.
